![illustration of tekpon recognition of formester as top form builder software](https://formester-strapi.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/Blog_Cover_Images_1_3248e3d522.png)

We're excited to announce that Tekpon has recognized Formester as one of the **[best form builder software](https://tekpon.com/categories/form-builder-software/)** for the year 2024! 

In their latest industry report, **[Tekpon has recognized Formester as a leading software solution in the form builder category](https://tekpon.com/software/formester/reviews/)**. This highlights our commitment to offering a user-friendly and efficient tool for creating online forms, surveys, and quizzes.

Our goal is to make form creation simple and efficient, so you can focus on what matters most. This recognition confirms that we’re on the right track and encourages us to keep improving.

## About Tekpon
**Tekpon** is a trusted platform that reviews and compares different software tools. They aim to help users and businesses make informed decisions by providing honest and detailed reviews.

The Tekpon team, made up of experts, **carefully reviews various tools** in different categories to create detailed industry reports. These reports are helpful for people looking for the best software solutions.

Tekpon helps people and businesses make decisions about software by comparing and evaluating options. Their **reports** make it easier to choose the best solutions for your needs and save time.

**In the report - Tekpon Said** “**[Formester](/)** offers a straightforward form builder that focuses on simplicity and efficiency. Businesses can create and manage forms for various purposes, including lead generation, surveys, and feedback with ease.

Formester stands out for its user-friendly interface, customizable templates, and seamless integration with marketing tools. The platform’s real-time analytics provide valuable insights into form performance and user engagement. For businesses seeking a hassle-free form-building solution, **Formester is an excellent choice!**”

## Why did they choose Formester?
Tekpon’s expert panel reviewed many form builders to compile their Top 10 Form Builders for 2024 report. Formester stood out for several reasons:

**User-Friendly Interface:** Our drag-and-drop editor makes form building as simple and easy as possible. You don’t need any coding skills to build and customize amazing forms that will engage with your audience.

**Advanced Features:** Formester has many advanced features. These include conditional logic, automatic email responses, auto-save, calculation fields, and more. All of these features are included in the free plan.

**Wide Range of Uses:** Create forms for any purpose—lead registrations, surveys, feedback, and more. Formester offers over 600+ Free Templates that allows you to create advanced forms in minutes!

**Collaborative Tools:** Work together with team members on form creation. Our platform supports multi-user collaboration, making it easier to build, design and fill forms together as a team.


We appreciate Tekpon for acknowledging us. We are excited to offer a user-friendly form-building experience. This experience will cater to both experts and beginners. Our goal is to keep improving our form building software to meet all your needs. If you haven’t tried Formester yet, now is a great time to see why we’re a top choice for form building!

**Thank you to Tekpon** for this wonderful recognition! We’re proud to be among the best and look forward to working with you again in the future!
